title: Lemniska — Telehealth & Care Marketplace
subtitle: Cross-Platform Doctor Consultation & AI Health Assistant
headline: HIPAA-compliant telemedicine ecosystem connecting 5,000+ active patients with verified medical specialists, second opinions, and AI health assistance.
summary: Architected and engineered by founding engineer Gurmeet (bringing 7+ years of core software engineering experience from his previous company tenure). Lemniska is an end-to-end digital health ecosystem featuring on-demand doctor consultations across 10+ specialties, an AI-powered triage buddy, interactive wellness video feeds, and encrypted medical records, serving over 5,000+ downloads on Google Play Store.
whatWasBuilt: Cross-platform mobile application with on-demand doctor booking across 10+ specialties, video e-consultations, an interactive AI Buddy assistant, 'Healthy Media' wellness reel feeds, multi-lingual doctor listings (English, Hindi, Punjabi), and secure OTP/social authentication.
technicalChallenge: Engineering a HIPAA-compliant telehealth and patient records pipeline requiring ultra-low-latency appointment scheduling, secure multimedia streams, and high-concurrency availability feeds while safeguarding sensitive protected health information (PHI) with zero data leakage across intermittent mobile network connections.
architecturalSolution: Developed cross-platform mobile client architecture using React Native with tokenized state persistence, end-to-end encrypted REST/WebSocket APIs, edge-cached video delivery for wellness media, and modular doctor-patient appointment dispatching with automatic reconnection.
highlights: 5,000+ verified active downloads on Google Play Store
Engineered by founding developer Gurmeet (7+ years engineering expertise)
HIPAA-compliant architecture with encrypted consultations & records
Integrated 'AI Buddy' conversational triage assistant for 24/7 patient guidance
Doctor marketplace with 270+ verified specialists across multi-lingual consults
'Healthy Media' short-form wellness video reels and patient rewards program
